long_biography.plain_text:
Sonic Automotive assembled automobile dealerships into a public retail platform, with B. Scott Smith serving as co-founder and an early operating leader. Before the company formed, he managed Town & Country Ford and held minority interests in that dealership and Fort Mill Ford. At Sonic, he moved through president, operating and strategy roles before becoming chief executive, while helping shape the pre-owned retail business that became EchoPark.

Smith left daily management in 2018 and rejoined Sonic’s board in 2022. Sonic now identifies him as a director, an officer of Sonic Financial Corporation, its largest shareholder, and a co-owner of Speedway Motorsports. These are board and ownership roles; his brother David serves as Sonic’s chairman and chief executive.
